_note: Chapter 22 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: The noise level in the library is acceptable to most students.
ex.cn: 图书馆里的噪音水平，对大多数学生来说是可以接受的。
ex.note: acceptable to sb. 对某人来说可以接受

ex.en: The library is just across the road from the dormitory.
ex.cn: 图书馆就在宿舍楼的马路对面。
ex.note: across from 在…对面；across the country 全国

ex.en: They advertise their products on the local radio station.
ex.cn: 他们在本地广播电台上为产品做广告。
ex.note: advertise sth. 做广告宣传；advertise for 招聘

ex.en: The airline added three new flights to the route last month.
ex.cn: 这家航空公司上月为这条航线新增了三个航班。
ex.note: an airline company 航空公司；airline ticket 机票

ex.en: Her ambition is to run a small bookshop of her own.
ex.cn: 她的志向是开一家属于自己的小书店。
ex.note: have the ambition to do 有…的志向；fulfil one's ambition 实现抱负

ex.en: The bowl he bought at the market turned out to be an antique.
ex.cn: 他在集市上买的那个碗，结果是件古董。
ex.note: an antique dealer 古董商

ex.en: They filled the corner of the room with antique furniture.
ex.cn: 他们用古董家具把这个房间的一角填满了。
ex.note: antique furniture 古董家具

ex.en: As we approached the station, the crowd grew thicker.
ex.cn: 我们越靠近车站，人群就越密。
ex.note: approach sb./sth. 接近某人或某物

ex.en: We need a completely different approach to this problem.
ex.cn: 解决这个问题，我们完全需要换一种思路。
ex.note: an approach to doing … 做…的方法；take a different approach 采取不同的做法

ex.en: As the train pulled in, the platform filled with families.
ex.cn: 火车进站时，站台上挤满了回家的人。
ex.note: as + 句子 表时间或原因；as if 好像

ex.en: She works as a nurse at a hospital near the campus.
ex.cn: 她在校园附近的一家医院当护士。
ex.note: work as … 担任…；as a result 结果

ex.en: He worked hard for years to attain his goal of studying abroad.
ex.cn: 他努力了多年，才实现出国留学的目标。
ex.note: attain one's goal 达成目标；attain a high standard 达到高标准

ex.en: The weather was awful, so we stayed indoors all day.
ex.cn: 天气糟透了，我们整天待在屋里。
ex.note: awful weather 糟糕的天气；an awful lot of 极多的

ex.en: The dog began to bark as soon as the stranger appeared.
ex.cn: 陌生人一出现，那条狗就叫了起来。
ex.note: bark at sb. 朝某人叫；bark of a tree 树皮

ex.en: They left early because the last bus had already gone.
ex.cn: 他们早早就走了，因为末班车已经开走了。
ex.note: because of 因为（后接名词或代词）

ex.en: Besides English, she speaks a little Japanese.
ex.cn: 除了英语，她还会说一点日语。
ex.note: besides 除…之外（还）；besides that 此外

ex.en: His knee began to bleed after he fell off the bike.
ex.cn: 他从自行车上摔下来以后，膝盖开始流血。
ex.note: bleed to death 失血而死；bleed for bleeding 拼死

ex.en: She was born in a small village near the sea.
ex.cn: 她出生在海边的一个小村庄里。
ex.note: be born with 天生具备；be born to do 命中注定要做

ex.en: A stone bridge crosses the river behind the campus.
ex.cn: 校园后面的小河上有一座石桥。
ex.note: build a bridge 架桥；a bridge between … …之间的桥梁

ex.en: The new book bridges the gap between theory and practice.
ex.cn: 这本新书把理论与实践之间的鸿沟架了起来。
ex.note: bridge the gap 弥合差距

ex.en: The market was busy even on a cold weekday.
ex.cn: 即使在寒冷的工作日，集市上也熙熙攘攘。
ex.note: be busy with 忙于；the busy season 旺季

ex.en: The hospital holds a charity run for children with cancer.
ex.cn: 医院为患癌儿童举办了一场慈善跑。
ex.note: lung cancer 肺癌；a cancer fund 癌症基金

ex.en: The teacher cast the new play and chose ten students for the roles.
ex.cn: 老师为这出新剧选角，挑了十名学生来演。
ex.note: cast sb. as sth. 让某人扮演某角色

ex.en: The cast of the film includes several new actors.
ex.cn: 这部电影的演员阵容里有几位新面孔。
ex.note: a cast of thousands 数千人的演员阵容

ex.en: Please take a chair; the meeting will begin in a moment.
ex.cn: 请坐，会议一会儿就开始了。
ex.note: chair of the committee 委员会主席；take a chair 坐下

ex.en: He cherished the quiet evenings of his childhood.
ex.cn: 他珍藏着童年里那些安静的夜晚。
ex.note: cherish the memory of 珍爱…的记忆；cherish a hope 怀有希望

ex.en: The city is famous for its old harbour and its seafood market.
ex.cn: 这座城市以老港口和海鲜市场闻名。
ex.note: the city of … …市

ex.en: Warm clothing is essential when you travel north in winter.
ex.cn: 冬天往北走，暖和的衣服必不可少。
ex.note: protective clothing 防护服；food and clothing 衣食

ex.en: The course combines theory with a lot of practical work.
ex.cn: 这门课把理论和大量的实际操作结合起来。
ex.note: combine A with B 把 A 和 B 结合起来

ex.en: She won first prize in the national writing competition.
ex.cn: 她在全国写作比赛中获得了一等奖。
ex.note: enter/win a competition 参加/赢得比赛；competition for 竞争者

ex.en: The whole class condemned the act of cheating.
ex.cn: 全班同学都谴责了作弊的行为。
ex.note: condemn sb. for sth. 因某事谴责某人

ex.en: The repairs cost a considerable amount of money.
ex.cn: 这次维修花掉了相当可观的一笔钱。
ex.note: a considerable amount of 大量的

ex.en: Every student was asked to make a small contribution to the fund.
ex.cn: 每个学生都被要求向这项基金捐一点钱。
ex.note: make a contribution to 为…作出贡献或捐款

ex.en: The film tells the story of a corrupt official in a small town.
ex.cn: 这部影片讲述了一个小镇上贪腐官员的故事。
ex.note: corrupt officials 贪官污吏

ex.en: Years of poor management had corrupted the whole system.
ex.cn: 多年的管理不善把整套制度腐蚀掉了。
ex.note: corrupt one's mind 腐蚀某人的心灵

ex.en: A snail crawled slowly across the wet path.
ex.cn: 一只蜗牛慢慢地爬过湿漉漉的小路。
ex.note: crawl along 爬行；crawl to sb. 爬向某人

ex.en: The actor missed his cue and stood silently on the stage.
ex.cn: 演员错过了一个提示，静静地站在台上。
ex.note: give sb. the cue 给某人提示；take one's cue from sb. 仿效某人

ex.en: She did not dare to speak in front of the whole class.
ex.cn: 她不敢在全班同学面前讲话。
ex.note: dare to do sth. 敢于做某事；dare sb. to do 激将某人做

ex.en: His declaration of love took everyone by surprise.
ex.cn: 他的表白让所有人都吃了一惊。
ex.note: a declaration of independence 独立宣言；make a declaration 发表声明

ex.en: The forest was so dense that no sunlight reached the ground.
ex.cn: 森林浓密得透不进一丝阳光。
ex.note: dense fog 浓雾；a dense population 稠密的人口

ex.en: The fire caused the destruction of hundreds of old houses.
ex.cn: 那场火灾毁掉了数百座老房子。
ex.note: the destruction of … …的毁灭

ex.en: They had to dig deep holes in the lawn for the poles.
ex.cn: 他们不得不在草坪上挖出深洞来插杆子。
ex.note: dig into 挖掘；dig up 掘出

ex.en: We discussed the plan for an hour before agreeing.
ex.cn: 我们讨论了一小时的方案才达成一致。
ex.note: discuss doing sth. 讨论做某事

ex.en: Their divorce was quiet, but it changed the whole family.
ex.cn: 他们的离婚很平静，却改变了整个家庭。
ex.note: get divorced 离婚；a divorce case 离婚案

ex.en: She divorced her husband after only three years of marriage.
ex.cn: 结婚才三年，她就和丈夫离了婚。
ex.note: divorce sb. 与某人离婚

ex.en: He read the first draft of the report before printing it.
ex.cn: 他把报告的初稿读了一遍才付印。
ex.note: the first draft 初稿；a draft of a contract 合同草稿

ex.en: Two students were drafted into the organizing team.
ex.cn: 两名学生被选调进了筹办小组。
ex.note: be drafted into 被征召进入…

ex.en: The ceremony lasted for the duration of an entire afternoon.
ex.cn: 典礼持续了整整一个下午。
ex.note: for the duration of 在…期间

ex.en: She edited the program and corrected all the spelling errors.
ex.cn: 她编辑了节目单，改正了所有的拼写错误。
ex.note: edit a manuscript 编辑手稿；edit video 剪辑影片

ex.en: The largest elephant in the zoo eats about two hundred kilos of leaves a day.
ex.cn: 动物园里最大的大象一天要吃大约两百公斤树叶。
ex.note: a white elephant 白象（昂贵而无用的东西）

ex.en: The film has a happy ending, but a rather slow middle.
ex.cn: 这部电影结局圆满，只是中间有些慢。
ex.note: come to an ending 有了结局

ex.en: All the players have an equal chance to win.
ex.cn: 所有选手获胜的机会均等。
ex.note: be equal to 与…相等；on equal terms 在同等条件下

ex.en: Three times two equals six.
ex.cn: 三乘以二等于六。
ex.note: equal sth. in size 与某物大小相等

ex.en: The police found no evidence of any wrongdoing.
ex.cn: 警方没有找到任何不当行为的证据。
ex.note: evidence of/for … …的证据；on the evidence of 根据…的证据

ex.en: A good library must exist in every university.
ex.cn: 一所好大学里必定有一座好图书馆。
ex.note: exist in 存在于；exist for 存在的原因

ex.en: The road was extremely slippery after the heavy rain.
ex.cn: 大雨过后，路面滑得厉害。
ex.note: extremely + adj. 极其…

ex.en: The train fare to the city centre is quite reasonable.
ex.cn: 到市中心的火车票价相当合理。
ex.note: bus fare 公交车费；pay the fare 付车费

ex.en: She feeds the stray cat every evening under the bridge.
ex.cn: 她每天傍晚都在桥下喂那只流浪猫。
ex.note: feed sth. to sb. 把某物喂给某人；feed on 以…为食

ex.en: The cattle are given a dry feed during the winter months.
ex.cn: 冬天的几个月里，牛都吃干饲料。
ex.note: a feed of … 一餐…

ex.en: I find it hard to concentrate in a noisy room.
ex.cn: 我发现自己在嘈杂的房间里很难集中注意力。
ex.note: find it + adj. to do 发现做某事…；find out 查明

ex.en: Traffic flowed slowly through the narrow street.
ex.cn: 车流缓缓流过狭窄的街道。
ex.note: a steady flow of 源源不断的…

ex.en: She forgave her brother for being late again.
ex.cn: 她原谅了哥哥再次迟到。
ex.note: forgive sb. for sth. 原谅某人做某事

ex.en: We need some fresh air after being inside all day.
ex.cn: 在屋里待了一整天，我们需要一些新鲜空气。
ex.note: fresh air 新鲜空气；fresh evidence 新证据

ex.en: Nobody can predict what the future will bring.
ex.cn: 没有人能预测未来会带来什么。
ex.note: in the future 将来；the future of … …的未来

ex.en: The young team is the future of the company.
ex.cn: 这支年轻的队伍是公司的未来。
ex.note: future plans 未来的计划

ex.en: The course covers both the history and the geography of the region.
ex.cn: 这门课涵盖这个地区的历史与地理。
ex.note: physical geography 自然地理；human geography 人文地理

ex.en: She said goodbye at the gate and walked away quickly.
ex.cn: 她在门口道了别，然后快步走开了。
ex.note: say goodbye to sb. 向某人告别

ex.en: Gravity keeps the moon in orbit around the earth.
ex.cn: 重力使月亮绕着地球运行。
ex.note: the law of gravity 重力定律；the gravity of the situation 事态的严重性

ex.en: The guy at the next table ordered two bowls of noodles.
ex.cn: 邻桌那个小伙子点了两碗面。
ex.note: a guy like you 像你这样的人；guys 伙计们

ex.en: The autumn harvest was the best in ten years.
ex.cn: 今年秋收是十年来最好的一次。
ex.note: a good harvest 丰收；harvest time 收获季节

ex.en: Farmers harvest the rice in late September.
ex.cn: 农民在九月下旬收割稻子。
ex.note: harvest crops 收割作物

ex.en: He said hello and asked how the trip had been.
ex.cn: 他打了个招呼，问这趟旅途怎么样。
ex.note: say hello to sb. 向某人问好

ex.en: He is taking a course in modern world history.
ex.cn: 他正在上一门世界近代史的课。
ex.note: make history 创造历史；local history 地方史

ex.en: They booked a small hotel near the train station.
ex.cn: 他们在火车站附近订了一家小旅馆。
ex.note: stay at a hotel 住旅馆

ex.en: Can you identify the man who took the box?
ex.cn: 你能认出那个拿走箱子的人吗？
ex.note: identify sb./sth. 识别；identify A as B 把 A 认定为 B

ex.en: It is important to check the figures twice.
ex.cn: 把数字核对两遍很重要。
ex.note: be important to sb. 对某人很重要

ex.en: The fishing industry supports hundreds of families in the town.
ex.cn: 渔业支撑着这个镇子几百个家庭。
ex.note: the tourist industry 旅游业；hard work and industry 勤奋

ex.en: Please keep your luggage inside the hall.
ex.cn: 请把行李放在大厅里面。
ex.note: inside and out 里里外外；inside information 内幕消息

ex.en: The inside of the old clock was covered with dust.
ex.cn: 那只旧钟的内部积满了灰尘。
ex.note: on the inside 在内部；从里面看

ex.en: The inside walls of the tent were wet with dew.
ex.cn: 帐篷的内壁被露水打湿了。
ex.note: inside walls 内墙；the inside story 内情

ex.en: The interior of the temple was painted with bright colours.
ex.cn: 庙宇的内部绘着鲜艳的图案。
ex.note: the interior of … …的内部

ex.en: The car has a warm and quiet interior.
ex.cn: 这辆车的内室温暖而安静。
ex.note: interior design 室内设计

ex.en: The lamp casts a long shadow; its light reaches the far wall.
ex.cn: 这盏灯投下长长的影子；它的光一直照到远端的墙。
ex.note: its 是物主代词，it's 是 it is

ex.en: All junior students must attend the orientation on Friday.
ex.cn: 所有低年级学生都必须参加周五的入学指导。
ex.note: junior year 大学三年级；junior high 初中

ex.en: The junior was asked to help with the equipment.
ex.cn: 那名低年级学生被叫来帮忙搬器材。
ex.note: a junior in a firm 公司里的初级职员

ex.en: A good teacher shares knowledge without showing off.
ex.cn: 好老师分享知识，却从不卖弄。
ex.note: have a knowledge of 懂…；common knowledge 常识

ex.en: Anyone who breaks the law will be punished.
ex.cn: 任何违法的人都会受到惩罚。
ex.note: pass a law 通过法律；the law of nature 自然规律

ex.en: Could you lend me your notes for the lecture?
ex.cn: 你能把听课笔记借给我吗？
ex.note: lend sb. sth. 把某物借给某人；lend a hand 帮忙

ex.en: The new bridge links the two halves of the city.
ex.cn: 这座新桥把城市的两半连在了一起。
ex.note: link A to B 把 A 和 B 联系起来

ex.en: There is a clear link between effort and results.
ex.cn: 努力和结果之间有明显的联系。
ex.note: a link between … …之间的联系；click the link 点击链接

ex.en: She wrote my name in a loop on the back of the book.
ex.cn: 她把我的名字用花体写在书的封底上。
ex.note: a loop of rope 一圈绳子；in a loop 陷入循环

ex.en: The compass needle is magnetic and always points north.
ex.cn: 指南针的针有磁性，总是指向北方。
ex.note: magnetic field 磁场；magnetic force 磁力

ex.en: Their marriage has survived thirty years of hard work.
ex.cn: 他们的婚姻经受住了三十年的辛劳。
ex.note: a happy marriage 幸福的婚姻；marriage of convenience 利益婚姻

ex.en: The old clock in the hall runs on a mechanical movement.
ex.cn: 大厅里那口老钟靠机械机芯运转。
ex.note: mechanical clock 机械钟；mechanical engineering 机械工程

ex.en: The ceremony begins at midnight on New Year's Eve.
ex.cn: 仪式在除夕午夜开始。
ex.note: at midnight 在午夜；before/after midnight 午夜前后

ex.en: Add water slowly until the mixture turns smooth.
ex.cn: 慢慢加水，直到混合物变得顺滑。
ex.note: a mixture of … …的混合物

ex.en: Teachers know that praise is a strong motivation for young learners.
ex.cn: 老师们知道，表扬对年轻的学习者是很好的激励。
ex.note: motivation for doing … 做…的动力；intrinsic motivation 内在动机

ex.en: The branches stood naked against the grey sky.
ex.cn: 那些枝条光秃秃地立在灰蒙蒙的天空前。
ex.note: to the naked eye 肉眼可见；naked light 裸露的光线

ex.en: My nephew is learning to make dumplings with his grandmother.
ex.cn: 我的侄子正在跟奶奶学包饺子。
ex.note: niece and nephew 侄甥

ex.en: A bowl of hot noodles is the cheapest meal on the street.
ex.cn: 一碗热面是街上最便宜的一顿饭。
ex.note: noodle shop 面馆；instant noodles 方便面

ex.en: Every object in the shop window carries a small price tag.
ex.cn: 橱窗里的每件东西都系着一张小价签。
ex.note: a solid object 实体；the object of … …的对象

ex.en: Few students objected to the idea of a night class.
ex.cn: 很少有学生反对开夜间课程这个主意。
ex.note: object to sth. 反对某事

ex.en: Oh, I forgot to post the letter again.
ex.cn: 啊，我又忘了寄信了。
ex.note: Oh no! 糟了！；Oh, come on! 得了吧！

ex.en: The satellite completes one orbit around the earth every ninety minutes.
ex.cn: 这颗卫星每九十分钟绕地球运行一周。
ex.note: in orbit 在轨道上；put into orbit 送入轨道

ex.en: The moon orbits the earth, and the earth orbits the sun.
ex.cn: 月球绕着地球转，地球绕着太阳转。
ex.note: orbit around 绕…运行

ex.en: She put the roast duck into the oven at four o'clock.
ex.cn: 她四点钟把烤鸭放进了烤箱。
ex.note: bake/roast in the oven 用烤箱烘烤；oven temperature 烤箱温度

ex.en: He wiped the flour from his palm with a cloth.
ex.cn: 他用布擦掉手上的面粉。
ex.note: palm of the hand 手心；palm tree 棕榈树

ex.en: He could not forget the past, though he had learned to forgive it.
ex.cn: 他无法忘记过去，却已学会了原谅。
ex.note: in the past 在过去；the past 无法挽回的过去

ex.en: For the past three weeks she has worked every evening.
ex.cn: 过去三个星期，她每天晚上都在工作。
ex.note: in the past few years 在过去几年里

ex.en: It is half past eight; we should go now.
ex.cn: 现在八点半了，我们该走了。
ex.note: half past … …点半；past midnight 午夜之后

ex.en: The admission fee is fifty yuan per person.
ex.cn: 入场费是每人五十元。
ex.note: per day/per week 每天/每周；per capita 人均

ex.en: She took a photo of the class in front of the old gate.
ex.cn: 她在老校门前给全班拍了一张照片。
ex.note: take a photo of 给…拍照；photo album 相册

ex.en: A plane passed low over the campus at sunset.
ex.cn: 日落时分，一架飞机低低地飞过校园上空。
ex.note: board a plane 登机；plane geometry 平面几何

ex.en: She polished the old brass clock until it shone.
ex.cn: 她把那只旧铜钟擦得锃亮。
ex.note: polish one's skills 磨炼技能；polish up 修饰

ex.en: A little polish on the wood makes all the difference.
ex.cn: 木头稍微打磨一下，效果就大不相同。
ex.note: nail polish 指甲油；a high polish 高光泽

ex.en: There was a post at the end of the path with the name of the village on it.
ex.cn: 小径尽头立着一根柱子，上面写着村子的名字。
ex.note: post office 邮局；a job post 职位

ex.en: She posted the letter before she left for the office.
ex.cn: 她出门上班前把信寄了。
ex.note: post a notice 张贴通知；post a letter 寄信

ex.en: She spent the whole afternoon preparing the ingredients.
ex.cn: 她花了整个下午准备食材。
ex.note: prepare for 为…做准备；prepare sth. 准备某物

ex.en: He kept his worries private and told nobody.
ex.cn: 他把烦恼藏在心里，谁也没告诉。
ex.note: private life 私生活；private property 私有财产

ex.en: The landlord is selling the property at the end of the street.
ex.cn: 房东正在出售街尾那处房产。
ex.note: return the property 归还财物；property damage 财产损失

ex.en: A group of pupils from the village school visited the museum.
ex.cn: 一所乡村学校的学生参观了博物馆。
ex.note: primary pupils 小学生；a pupil of … …的学生

ex.en: He turned on the radio to hear the morning news.
ex.cn: 他打开收音机听早间新闻。
ex.note: on the radio 在广播中；radio station 广播电台

ex.en: The painting is so realistic that you can see the rain on it.
ex.cn: 这幅画逼真极了，你仿佛能看见上面的雨丝。
ex.note: be realistic about 对…持现实态度；a realistic chance 现实的机会

ex.en: Keep this book as a reference for future work.
ex.cn: 把这本书留着，以后工作时作参考。
ex.note: for reference 供参考；reference book 参考书；letters of reference 推荐信

ex.en: It was a relief to hear that her family was safe.
ex.cn: 听说家人平安，他松了一口气。
ex.note: to one's relief 令人欣慰的是；a relief from 缓解

ex.en: The job requires a knowledge of statistics.
ex.cn: 这份工作需要懂统计。
ex.note: require sth. of sb. 向某人要求某物；require doing 需要做

ex.en: The old bottle retains the smell of the wine inside it.
ex.cn: 这只旧瓶子保留着里面那酒的气味。
ex.note: retain control 保持控制；retain one's memory 保有记忆

ex.en: She roasted the duck until the skin turned golden.
ex.cn: 她把鸭子烤到皮变成金黄色。
ex.note: roast a chicken 烤鸡；roast beef 烤牛肉

ex.en: For dinner we had roast beef and potatoes.
ex.cn: 晚饭我们吃了烤牛肉和土豆。
ex.note: a roast dinner 烤宴

ex.en: A rumor about the closure spread through the town in a day.
ex.cn: 关于倒闭的谣言一天之内就传遍了小镇。
ex.note: a rumor about 关于…的传闻；rumor has it 据说

ex.en: The cup of tea came with a small saucer.
ex.cn: 那杯茶配着一只小茶碟。
ex.note: a cup and saucer 一杯茶和茶碟

ex.en: The cat scratched the back of my hand.
ex.cn: 猫抓了我手背。
ex.note: scratch a surface 划伤表面；scratch one's head 挠头

ex.en: There is a deep scratch on the door.
ex.cn: 门上有一道深深的划痕。
ex.note: a scratch on … …上的划痕；from scratch 从零开始

ex.en: A new semester begins in early September.
ex.cn: 新学期九月初开始。
ex.note: the fall/spring semester 秋季/春季学期

ex.en: He shakes his head and refuses to answer whenever he disagrees.
ex.cn: 每逢有不同意见，他就摇头，不肯回答。
ex.note: shake hands 握手；a shake of the head 摇头

ex.en: You should tell your parents before you leave.
ex.cn: 你走之前应该告诉父母。
ex.note: should have done 本该做（而没做）

ex.en: Her apology was sincere, and everyone accepted it.
ex.cn: 她的道歉很诚恳，大家都接受了。
ex.note: sincere thanks 真诚的感谢；be sincere about 对…真诚

ex.en: There was a slight delay in the train's arrival.
ex.cn: 火车到达时略有延误。
ex.note: a slight difference 细微的差别；slight pain 轻微的疼痛

ex.en: The company designs software for small factories.
ex.cn: 这家公司为小型工厂设计软件。
ex.note: software engineering 软件工程；free software 自由软件

ex.en: They drove south for three hours before they stopped.
ex.cn: 他们向南开了三个小时才停下来。
ex.note: in the south 在南方；the south of China 中国南方

ex.en: The old festival is still alive in the spirit of the people.
ex.cn: 这个古老的节日仍然活在人们的精神里。
ex.note: in spirit 在精神上；team spirit 团队精神

ex.en: The stars were clear and cold above the quiet campus.
ex.cn: 安静的校园上空，星星清冷而明亮。
ex.note: a film star 影星；the stars 群星

ex.en: The young actor starred in his first film last year.
ex.cn: 这位年轻演员去年主演了他的第一部电影。
ex.note: star in a film 在电影中主演

ex.en: My stomach hurt after I tasted too many dumplings.
ex.cn: 尝了太多饺子以后，我的胃开始疼。
ex.note: on an empty stomach 空着肚子；stomachache 胃痛

ex.en: The painter finished the last stroke of the river with one sweep.
ex.cn: 画家最后一笔扫过，画完了那条河。
ex.note: a stroke of the brush 一笔画；a stroke of luck 走运

ex.en: She stroked the cat's back until it fell asleep.
ex.cn: 她抚着猫的背，直到它睡着了。
ex.note: stroke sb.'s hair 抚摸某人的头发

ex.en: He wore a dark suit to the interview.
ex.cn: 他穿着一身深色西装去面试。
ex.note: a suit and tie 一套西装；bring a suit against sb. 起诉某人

ex.en: This colour does not suit you at all.
ex.cn: 这个颜色一点也不适合你。
ex.note: suit sb. 适合某人；be suited for 适合…

ex.en: The old clock was a pleasant surprise at the end of the tour.
ex.cn: 行程尽头的那口老钟是个让人愉快的惊喜。
ex.note: to one's surprise 令人惊讶的是；a pleasant surprise 意外的惊喜

ex.en: The result surprised everyone in the office.
ex.cn: 这个结果让办公室里所有人都吃了一惊。
ex.note: surprise sb. 使某人吃惊；be surprised at 对…感到惊讶

ex.en: The team must tackle the problem before the term ends.
ex.cn: 团队必须在本学期结束前解决这个问题。
ex.note: tackle a problem 处理问题；tackle crime 打击犯罪

ex.en: He put his fishing tackle in the back of the car.
ex.cn: 他把渔具放在汽车后座上。
ex.note: fishing tackle 渔具

ex.en: We looked at the moon through a small telescope.
ex.cn: 我们用一架小望远镜看月亮。
ex.note: a telescope on a tripod 架在三脚架上的望远镜

ex.en: The theft was reported to the campus police at once.
ex.cn: 这桩盗窃案立刻报告给了校警。
ex.note: a theft of … …的盗窃；prevent theft 防盗

ex.en: Though it was raining, we walked to the station.
ex.cn: 虽然下着雨，我们还是走去了车站。
ex.note: though + 句子 虽然；even though 即使

ex.en: The film was long, though the story was good.
ex.cn: 这部电影有点长，不过故事不错。
ex.note: though 作副词置于句末 表示转折

ex.en: A tiny shop stood at the corner of the street.
ex.cn: 街角有一家小小的店铺。
ex.note: a tiny bit of 一点点

ex.en: We took a guided tour of the old city on foot.
ex.cn: 我们跟着导游徒步逛了老城。
ex.note: a guided tour 有导游的游览；on a tour 在游览中

ex.en: They toured the old town in the afternoon.
ex.cn: 他们下午逛遍了老城。
ex.note: tour a country 周游某国

ex.en: She carried a tray of hot tea into the hall.
ex.cn: 她端着一盘热茶走进大厅。
ex.note: a tray of cups 一盘杯子；serving tray 服务托盘

ex.en: He could not pay the tuition for the second year.
ex.cn: 他付不起第二年的学费。
ex.note: tuition fees 学费；tuition-free 免学费的

ex.en: He tried to undo the damage, but it was too late.
ex.cn: 他试着挽回损失，却已经太晚了。
ex.note: undo the damage 弥补损失；undo a mistake 撤销错误

ex.en: The manager thanked us for the extra work.
ex.cn: 经理为我们的额外付出道了谢。
ex.note: us 是 we 的宾格；let us 让我们

ex.en: The only vehicle allowed inside the gate was a fire truck.
ex.cn: 唯一获准进入大门以内的车辆是一辆消防车。
ex.note: motor vehicle 机动车；public transport vehicle 公共交通工具

ex.en: He promised to visit his parents in the summer.
ex.cn: 他答应夏天去看望父母。
ex.note: visit sb. 拜访某人；pay a visit to 拜访

ex.en: The doctor warned him not to work so hard.
ex.cn: 医生警告他不要这样拼命工作。
ex.note: warn sb. of/about sth. 就某事警告某人；warn sb. to do 告诫某人做

ex.en: She weighed every dumpling so that they were all of the same weight.
ex.cn: 她把每个饺子都称过，好让它们分量一样。
ex.note: lose weight 减肥；put on weight 增重

ex.en: To whom should I return the borrowed book?
ex.cn: 这本借来的书我该还给谁？
ex.note: who 与 whom 的区别：whom 作宾语

ex.en: The woman in the blue coat showed us the way.
ex.cn: 穿蓝大衣的那位女士给我们指了路。
ex.note: a young woman 年轻女子；women's rights 妇女权利

ex.en: We took the wrong bus and ended up at the airport.
ex.cn: 我们坐错了车，结果跑到了机场。
ex.note: the wrong way 方向不对；in the wrong place 在不对的地方

ex.en: Who is in the wrong in this argument?
ex.cn: 在这场争论中是谁不对？
ex.note: in the wrong 有错；right and wrong 是非曲直

ex.en: He guessed the answer wrong again.
ex.cn: 他又猜错了答案。
ex.note: go wrong 出问题；nothing wrong with … …没什么问题
